text:
samir: sec-bot alert: sudden spike in SSO failures for 6 distinct users across eu-west and us-east, lots of MFA push retries. looks like automated client retrying silently :eyes:
sec-bot: [automated] detection: SSO.SILENT_RETRY_LOOP count=243 window=15m src_ips=[54.12.34.56, 18.204.11.22] affected_users=[jdoe, mmendez, pgreen,...] severity=high
oncall: paging oncall — @oncall can you confirm region impact?
oncall: investigating, pulling auth logs now
alyssa: saw multiple failed SAML assertions followed immediately by MFA push events for same UIDs, then lockouts after 5 retries
maria: share sample logs?
oncall: pasted snippet from auth-proxy:
```
2026-03-19T22:11:08Z auth-proxy INFO SAML_ASSERTION_FAILURE uid=jdoe relay_state=/app/console ip=54.12.34.56 reason=INCOMPLETE_ASSERTION
2026-03-19T22:11:10Z auth-proxy INFO MFA_PUSH_SENT uid=jdoe provider=okta push_id=abc123
2026-03-19T22:11:12Z auth-proxy INFO MFA_RETRY uid=jdoe reason=CLIENT_RETRY
```
noah: that CLIENT_RETRY looks like client SDK retrying without waiting for user action — we've seen this with an older mobile SDK version
samir: can we confirm whether these retries are coming from mobile app versions or service accounts?
maria: cross-referencing UA and device_id — all are mobile iOS app v1.3.2 except one web session. looks like a bad update shipped yesterday
alyssa: impact: 6 user lockouts, 12 session revokes across two regions, increased helpdesk tickets. no confirmed credential compromise yet
oncall: containment: blocked the 2 offending source IPs at the WAF, rolled back mobile deploy v1.3.2 to v1.3.1 for iOS, and temporarily increased per-account backoff on SSO to 60s
samir: also revoked active sessions for affected accounts and forced re-auth for risky sessions. notified support to help users self-unlock :thumbsup:
noah: created a quick alert to detect client-side retry patterns and rate-limit SAML assertions per-device-id
maria: audit logs — please ensure we capture full SAML assertions and IdP response codes for postmortem. opened ticket INFRA-4523 to enable assertion logging (scrub PII)
alyssa: next steps for post-incident: 1) PR to mobile SDK to stop automatic retry when MFA pending, 2) add server-side per-device exponential backoff, 3) update runbook to include immediate rollback criteria for auth SDKs
samir: assign owners? mobile SDK fix -> @noah, server backoff -> @maria, runbook update -> @alyssa. Please add timelines in INFRA-4524
oncall: adding monitoring: patching alert to watch SSO.SILENT_RETRY_LOOP rate > 5/min and user lockouts > 3 in 10m
\sec-bot: [automated] note: created incident ticket INC-2026-0472
alyssa: comms: support draft ready, will send targeted note to affected users explaining forced logout and self-unlock steps. legal/sec: any need to notify customers more broadly?
\samir: not at this time — no evidence of creds exfiltration. continue monitoring for anomalies for 72h
noah: follow-up: will add KMS-wrapped log integrity flagging to make sure audit trail can't be tampered with in private deployments (low effort). created PR link in INFRA-4523
\maria: postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (mobile SDK retry logic), mitigations (WAF/IP block, rollback, backoff), telemetry gaps, and action owners
samir: thanks team. mark as active until 2026-03-22 22:00 UTC for monitoring window. i'll update once we clear
alyssa: acknowledged. will post postmortem draft in #incidents when ready :white_check_mark:
